<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that matches the target molecule and corresponds to the cycloaddition described. We'll search the template catalog for templates that form a C‑C bond (6‑6) and break a C‑O bond (6‑8), and that involve breaking a ketone and an alkyne functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
